meta.name: apple-reminders
meta.description: Manage Apple Reminders via remindctl CLI (list, add, edit, complete, delete). Supports lists, date filters, and JSON/plain output.

copy.tagline: 管理你的 Apple 提醒事项
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常用苹果设备管理待办事项
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often manage to-dos on Apple devices

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以通过 remindctl 命令行工具管理 Apple Reminders。支持列出、添加、完成、删除提醒事项，操作列表，按日期过滤，以及输出 JSON 或纯文本格式。
howto.when: 当用户提到“提醒事项”或“Reminders app”，或要求创建能同步到 iOS 设备的有到期日的待办事项时触发。

say.text: 列出今天的所有提醒事项。
在购物清单中添加“买牛奶”，明天到期。
say.note: 创建带列表和到期日的提醒。
标记指定 ID 的提醒为完成。

howto.what_en: Claude can manage Apple Reminders via the remindctl CLI: list, add, edit, complete, delete reminders; manage lists; filter by date; output JSON or plain text.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions 'reminder' or 'Reminders app', or wants to create due-date to-dos that sync to iOS devices.

say_en.text: List all my reminders for today.
Add 'Buy milk' to the Shopping list, due tomorrow.
say_en.note: Creates a reminder with list and due date.
Marks reminders with given IDs as done.
